[Act: income-tax-1961
 Chapter: Special Provisions Relating to Certain Persons Other Than a Company
 Section: 115JE::Application of other provisions of this Act.
]


Save as otherwise provided in this Chapter, all other provisions of this Act shall apply to a person referred to in this Chapter.
